scope: Four selected additions in 35,36,38,40; V34 hierarchy and V37 mobile only

figures.title: 同一格，三种结果
figures.condition: 图为确定性单格代数，不是Brownian路径面积。逐格右端−左端=(ΔX)²，对称−左端=(ΔX)²/2。连续半鞅在确定分割网格趋零时，对称端点和以ucp收敛：∫X∘dX=∫X dX+[X]/2；Brownian情形[B]ₜ=t。一般H、X用[H,X]。右端取值一般用到了本格未来；时间中点值未必等于端点值平均。

figures.title: One increment. Three results.
figures.condition: This is one deterministic cell, not Brownian area. Per cell, right minus left is (ΔX)² and symmetric minus left is (ΔX)²/2. For a continuous semimartingale, deterministic partitions with vanishing mesh give ucp convergence: ∫X∘dX=∫X dX+[X]/2; for Brownian motion [B]ₜ=t. Use [H,X] for general H,X. Right values generally use this cell’s future. A time midpoint need not equal the mean of endpoint values.

figures.title: 共同的是分布，不是每次的答案
figures.condition: R取1、2各半，ν=(δ₋R+δR)/2。给定ν，各次iid，每次独立重新抽取，不是无放回；未给ν时，四个值各1/4只是边缘律，不表示无条件独立。例中Cov(X₁,X₂)=0仍依赖。给定ν₂时不可能看到|X₁|=1，图中的“—”不是条件概率0。一般de Finetti表示仍需无限交换与标准Borel条件，有限交换性不够。

figures.title: A shared law, not shared outcomes
figures.condition: P(R=1)=P(R=2)=½ and ν=(δ₋R+δR)/2. Draws are iid given ν: fresh independent draws, not sampling without replacement. Four values of probability ¼ in the hidden state describe marginals, not unconditional independence; here Cov(X₁,X₂)=0 despite dependence. Given ν₂, |X₁|=1 is impossible: “—” is not a conditional probability of zero. The general de Finetti theorem needs infinite exchangeability and standard Borel assumptions, not finite exchangeability alone.

figures.title: 事件各占一票，时间按长度投票
figures.condition: 有限记录只示意权重：事件从0、1、4、5中均匀选，时间从[0,8)均匀选。八个方块各代表一单位时间，不是仅八个可选时刻。推广到平稳更新时，事件（Palm）律下间隔须为正、iid且0<E L<∞：P时间(L∈dℓ)=ℓ P事件(L∈dℓ)/E事件L。所见是含时刻的完整间隔，不是余寿命；事件观察读其后一个完整间隔。

figures.title: One vote per event, more time for longer gaps
figures.condition: The finite record illustrates weights: choose a start uniformly from {0,1,4,5}, or time uniformly from [0,8). Each square stands for a unit of time, not one of only eight possible times. For stationary renewal, the event (Palm) gaps must be positive and iid with 0<E L<∞: P_time(L∈dℓ)=ℓ P_event(L∈dℓ)/E_event L. Time sampling reads the full containing gap, not residual life; event sampling reads the next full gap.

figures.title: 不同时间，同一个祖先
figures.condition: 确定性连续折线示例：从0升到2、降到1、再升到2、回到0；不是Brownian样本。零距离需两端等高且中间不更低，不是只比较端点高度。实树、唯一弧与紧性仍由正文证明；时间质量不等于枝长。

figures.title: Different times, the same ancestor
figures.condition: A deterministic continuous excursion: 0→2→1→2→0, not a Brownian sample. Zero distance requires equal endpoint heights with no lower value between them. Endpoint heights alone are insufficient. The real-tree, unique-arc and compactness claims require the text’s proofs; time mass is not edge length.

figures.title: 长枝仍在，样本未必看到
figures.condition: X只含原枝[0,1]，Y含两枝，内在度量等同[−2,1]，根均为0。μ_ε=(1−ε)Unif[0,1]+εUnif[−2,0]，0<ε<1；拖动前后沿细线的距离不变；宽带不属于空间本身。图示质量连续，宽带不是几何厚度或原子。带宽按密度1−ε与ε/2变化；曲线仅示意内在树距离。五次均未落长枝的概率为(1−ε)⁵；一次模拟不能证明此式。抽样按钮使用新的有限精度均匀数作模拟；随后拖动滑块复用这组数作耦合演示，不表示重新独立抽样。上标r表示带根；GP按支撑加根识别，GHP采用同一嵌入下的max规范。

figures.title: The branch stays. Samples may miss it.
figures.condition: X is the old branch [0,1]; Y has both branches and is intrinsically [−2,1], with root 0. μ_ε=(1−ε)Unif[0,1]+εUnif[−2,0], 0<ε<1. Distances along the fine line stay fixed. The ribbon is not part of the metric space; mass is continuous, not atomic. Their widths follow densities 1−ε and ε/2; curves illustrate intrinsic tree distances. All five iid samples miss with probability (1−ε)⁵; simulation does not prove it. Draw simulates with fresh finite-precision uniform variates. Moving the slider then reuses those uniforms as a coupling, not a new independent sample. Superscript r denotes rooted distance; GP identifies support plus root, while GHP uses one common embedding and the max convention.

figures.title: 两种括号，是两种读取
figures.condition: 连续模型M=B，严格有[B]ₜ=⟨B⟩ₜ=t；一般[M]=⟨M⟩限于本章已证的连续局部鞅。跳跃模型M=N−t，N为率1的Poisson过程：[M]=N，⟨M⟩=t。图中到达记录只是确定性示意，不证明这些定理；“可预测”不是预言实际跳数。一般分割的收敛模式及局部化条件以正文为准。

figures.title: Two brackets, two ways to read
figures.condition: For M=B, [B]ₜ=⟨B⟩ₜ=t. The general equality in this chapter applies to continuous local martingales. For M=N−t with a rate-one Poisson N, [M]=N and ⟨M⟩=t. The arrival record is illustrative, not a proof; predictable does not mean foretelling the realized count. Partition convergence and localization retain the text’s hypotheses.

figures.title: 记录没动，概率重新分配
figures.condition: 图是有限类比，不是Brownian路径模拟。P给四条两步记录各1/4；Qθ给单步向上概率θ，两步独立。Zθ=Qθ/P，所以E_P Zθ=1；圆面积按概率、半径按概率平方根缩放。改变的是权重，不是已有记录。Brownian的有限时间换测度须另证随机指数为均值1真鞅；正局部鞅不自动是密度。此图不替代Girsanov证明，也不主张无限时间等价。

figures.title: Same records, different weights
figures.condition: This finite analogy is not a Brownian simulation. P gives each two-step record probability 1/4; under Qθ the steps are independent with up probability θ. Zθ=Qθ/P and E_P Zθ=1. Circle area, not radius, is proportional to probability. Only weights change. Brownian change of measure on a finite horizon separately requires a true density martingale of mean 1; a positive local martingale is insufficient. This is neither a Girsanov proof nor a claim of infinite-horizon equivalence.

figures.title: 一跳不能只留下二阶近似
figures.condition: 图画的是f的几何，不是时间样本路径；X跳过中间状态，不能沿图中的曲线逐点经过。以x=1、z=2计：f′(1)z=6，f″(1)z²/2=12，其余z³=8。Itô跳跃公式保留f(x+z)−f(x)−f′(x)z=20，不是只保留8，也不能把12作为一般跳跃的全部修正。连续二阶变差项与完整跳跃项的分工依正文定理。
figures.status: visual working draft adopted; targeted hierarchy refinement pending review

figures.title: A jump is more than its quadratic approximation
figures.condition: This is the geometry of f, not a time sample path: X jumps over the intermediate states. At x=1,z=2, f′(1)z=6, f″(1)z²/2=12 and the remaining z³=8. The Itô jump correction is f(x+z)−f(x)−f′(x)z=20, not just 8; the quadratic term 12 alone is also insufficient. The text’s theorem distinguishes continuous quadratic variation from the full jump term.

figures.title: 一点没有时间，密度却可以非零
figures.condition: 示意剖面ℓ(a)=(1−|a|)₊，不是声称Brownian局部时具有这条确定形状。其带内面积2ε−ε²除以2ε为1−ε/2，趋于ℓ(0)=1；单点面积为0，不能用0/0定义密度。正文实际证明Brownian占用公式∫₀ᵗ1{|Bₛ−a|<ε}ds=∫ₐ₋εᵃ₊εLₜʸdy及联合连续性，故窄带平均趋Lₜᵃ。一般连续半鞅须以d[M]而非一概用dt计量。图不代替局部时存在、版本与收敛证明。
figures.status: visual working draft adopted; mobile compact layout pending review

figures.title: Zero time at a point, nonzero density
figures.condition: The schematic profile ℓ(a)=(1−|a|)₊ is not asserted to be the local time of a Brownian sample. Band area 2ε−ε² divided by 2ε is 1−ε/2, tending to ℓ(0)=1. A point has zero area; 0/0 cannot define density. The text proves the Brownian occupation identity and joint continuity, which justify narrow-band averages tending to Lₜᵃ. General continuous semimartingales use d[M], not automatically dt. This diagram does not prove existence, versions or convergence of local time.

figures.title: 规则、唯一性、寿命不是一回事
figures.condition: 两例都取σ=0，不是假造随机样本。第一例xᵃ(t)=(t−a)₊²，a∈[0,∞]，在出发处导数两侧均为0，确实满足同一积分方程；在t=2分别读到4、1、0。第二例x′=x²、x(0)=1，局部唯一解1/(1−t)仅在t<1成立；不能在爆炸后填一个有限值续成原方程的解。四个节点只是读数序列，横距不表示相等时长。图不承担一般强弱解、路径唯一性与分布唯一性的分类证明。

figures.title: A rule, uniqueness and lifetime are different claims
figures.condition: Both examples have σ=0, not simulated noise. In the first, xᵃ(t)=(t−a)₊², a∈[0,∞], has derivative 0 on both sides of departure and satisfies the same integral equation; at t=2 the displayed values are 4,1,0. In the second, x′=x² with x(0)=1 has the locally unique solution 1/(1−t) only for t<1. A finite value cannot extend it past explosion as a solution of that equation. The four nodes are observations, not an equally spaced time axis. General strong/weak and uniqueness notions remain the text’s responsibility.

figures.title: 边界有两个方向的问题
figures.condition: 端点0在状态区间闭包中；入口指扩展状态空间后连续即时进入内部，不是仅在0定义一个常值过程。Σ有限表示内部可达；对不可达端点，N有限给出本章已证的即时入口。四型为(Σ,N)：有限/有限、有限/无穷、无穷/有限、无穷/无穷。正则型表示允许选择相应边界规则，不保证任意既定延拓都会反射返回。出口或自然端也可能定义吸收零过程，这不等于进入内部。使用本章非退化一维扩散的尺度与速度条件，不据此宣称所有奇异边界延拓已构造。

figures.title: A boundary poses two directional questions
figures.condition: Endpoint 0 lies in the closure of the state interval. Entrance means a continuous immediate entry into its interior after extension of the state space, not merely a constant process at 0. Finite Σ means accessibility; for inaccessible endpoints finite N gives the chapter’s proved entrance. The four (Σ,N) types are finite/finite, finite/infinite, infinite/finite and infinite/infinite. Regularity allows boundary choices; it does not force every extension to reflect. An absorbing zero process at an exit or natural endpoint is not an entrance. The chapter’s nondegenerate one-dimensional scale/speed assumptions apply; no general singular-boundary construction is claimed.

figures.title: 一段运动，两份累计
figures.condition: 这是无折扣q=0的明确区间模型，不是一般Feynman–Kac定理的替代。令τ为标准Brownian首次退出(0,1)，g(0)=0、g(1)=1，f≡c。Pₓ(Bτ=1)=x，Eₓτ=x(1−x)，故u(x)=Eₓ[g(Bτ)+cτ]=x+cx(1−x)，满足−u″/2=c及上述非零边界数据。两项来自同一段路径，通常相关；相加取期望不需独立性。图中钟面表示累计到τ，不是第三种退出结果。箭头概率不由模拟估计；一般正则性、存在与边界实现仍依正文。

figures.title: One stopped motion, two contributions
figures.condition: This is the explicit undiscounted model q=0, not a substitute for general Feynman–Kac. For standard Brownian exit time τ from (0,1), g(0)=0,g(1)=1 and f≡c, Pₓ(Bτ=1)=x and Eₓτ=x(1−x). Thus u(x)=Eₓ[g(Bτ)+cτ]=x+cx(1−x), satisfying −u″/2=c and the nonzero boundary data. The two contributions share one path and are generally dependent; linearity of expectation needs no independence. The clock is accumulation until τ, not a third exit outcome. Probabilities are exact, not simulated. General regularity, existence and boundary realization remain in the text.

figures.title: 同样的角度，半径却不同
figures.condition: 正确模型(X,Y)=(cosB,sinB)，dX=−YdB−Xdt/2，dY=XdB−Ydt/2，故X²+Y²=1。删掉两个dt项后，d(X²+Y²)=(X²+Y²)dt，从(1,0)出发半径为exp(t/2)；它与正确模型有相同角度B，但不是同一过程的另一种坐标写法。θ按钮是同一角度读数的示意，不是模拟轨迹，也不把Bₜ的分布离散化。向心漂移不表示真实路径沿半径内缩。Itô公式本身正确处理坐标变换，错误是遗漏二阶修正；圆周轮廓不表示各角度等概率。

figures.title: Same angle, different radius
figures.condition: The correct model is (cosB,sinB): dX=−YdB−Xdt/2 and dY=XdB−Ydt/2, so X²+Y²=1. Omitting both dt terms gives d(X²+Y²)=(X²+Y²)dt and radius exp(t/2) from (1,0). Its angle is still B, but it is a different process, not a new coordinate description of the same one. θ buttons illustrate one angular reading, not simulated trajectories or a discrete distribution for Bₜ. Inward Itô drift does not mean the actual path moves radially inward. Itô’s formula handles coordinate changes correctly; omitting the second-order correction is the error. Circle outlines do not assert a uniform angular law.
